text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"states a clear position against driverless cars and returns to it throughout","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay keeps a consistent claim in view and uses most paragraphs to support that stance."},{"evidence":"uses examples like paying $800 for phones, road construction costs, and liability questions","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay grounds its points in concrete details rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"asks and answers questions such as \"So why not drive yourself?\" and \"who is to blame?\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay expands ideas by explaining why the points matter and by anticipating consequences."},{"evidence":"moves from introduction to pro and con points to a closing question","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more recognizable argumentative structure with a beginning, development, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"more developed sentences connecting technology to cost and safety","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its claims more fully instead of listing brief, disconnected remarks."}]}
